conventions.perturbations: applied to the 128 px image, then CLIP's own resize/crop to 224 (as the ResNet study applied them at 128 px)
conventions.shift: circular shift of the preprocessed 224 x 224 tensor, down and right, by 6.25% (14 px) or 12.5% (28 px) of the width
conventions.standard_probe: trained on clean vectors; C, temperature and the 95%-accuracy answer threshold chosen on the clean validation set
conventions.augmented_probe: trained on clean + 2 photo-augmented draws of each train image (encoder frozen)
conventions.answered: top probability (after temperature) >= the validation threshold
